params.body:
## What

The reason of a failed adapter round was `String(errors[0])`, and six adapters pass an object (`{source, error}`, `{feed, error}`, `{region, error}`, `{domain, error}`). From 19 to 23 September every failed round of openalex, semantic-scholar and web-browse read `[object Object]` in `adapter_runs`, on the Collection screen and in what Elixir reads, so a rate limit could not be told from a dead feed.

## How

- `errorText()` in `packages/adapters/src/base.mjs` reads every shape an adapter passes (string, `Error`, object naming what failed), and never returns `[object Object]`: an unknown object becomes short JSON.
- `failureReason()` is the first error plus how many more ("src-academic-3: HTTP 429 (and 2 more)"), since one of fifteen failing is not all fifteen.
- Fixed in the one place that builds the reason, so no adapter has to change.

## Tests

`test/failure-reason.test.mjs` pins every shape and that nothing becomes `[object Object]`. `adapter-outcome.test.mjs` pinned "the first error only"; it now expects the count of the rest.
params.title: A failed round says why, not [object Object]
